hero.title:
Computational Multi-Physics Research Group
Indian Institute of Technology, Madras
hero.description: Bridging atoms to continuum, biology to ballistics — the CoMPhys Research Group at IIT Madras simulates every scale, every material, every interface, and every speed across defense, aerospace, energy, and bioinspired systems.

updates.title: Lumina Presented at HEMCE 2026!
updates.text: Our team successfully delivered a talk and presented our paper on 'Lumina: An AI-Augmented Multiscale Material Informatics Framework' at the HEMCE conference, showcasing offline AI data querying and HPC-ready material models for extreme engineering regimes.

updates.title: CoMPhys at INCAM 2026!
updates.text: The CoMPhys Research Group is headed to 7th Indian Conference on Applied Mechanics (INCAM 2026)! We will be presenting three exciting papers on adaptive implicit modeling (PyAMorph), stochastic microstructure transport (PuMA), and spatiotemporal stress prediction using ConvLSTM models. Catch up with us there to discuss collaboration!

updates.title: CFD Symposium 2026 at IIT Madras!
updates.text: As proud organizers of the Aeronautical Society of India's Annual CFD Symposium, we invite you to submit your abstracts. Showcase your breakthrough computational fluid dynamics research before the May 31st deadline! Submit here: https://www.cfdaesi.com/cfd-symposium-2026

updates.title: Hosting ICNMMF-6 at IIT Madras!
updates.text: We are excited to co-organize the 6th International Conference on Numerical Methods in Multiphase Flows (ICNMMF-6), taking place January 18-20, 2027, at IIT Madras. Join global experts in Chennai to discuss advanced multi-phase modeling. Details: https://ge.iitm.ac.in/icnmmf-6

whyChoose.heading: Why Choose Our Lab
whyChoose.description: Tackle extreme physics with interdisciplinary tools, strong team culture, and rigorous training — from fundamentals to impact.

items.title: Extreme Multiphysics
items.text: All Scales and Speeds. Model complex flows and materials across scales — from nature to impact. (Respecting nature’s richness, capturing it through computation)

items.title: Interdisciplinary Science Meets Real-World Problems
items.text: Start with real-world phenomena, model them, and drive practical innovation. (Observation leads to insight — insight leads to solutions)

items.title: Rigorous Training
items.text: Strong Team Culture. Learn to collaborate, code professionally, and use cutting-edge computing tools. (We grow researchers ready for science, industry, and leadership)

research.heading: Research Areas
research.description: Our multidisciplinary approach spans various domains of computational physics and engineering.

items.title: Bioinspired Flows
items.text: Modeling unsteady aerodynamics in nature’s flyers and biological systems.

items.title: Energetic Material Dynamics
items.text: Simulating shock, reaction, and detonation in high-energy materials.

items.title: Hypersonic Reentry Physics
items.text: Capturing extreme aerothermal loads, ablation, and gas-surface interactions.

items.title: High Strain-Rate Material Response
items.text: Understanding material deformation and failure under dynamic loading conditions.

items.title: AI-Driven Multi-Scale Modeling
items.text: Accelerating simulations using machine learning across scales and physics domains.

join.heading: Join Our Research Community
join.description: We welcome curious minds eager to learn, code, model, and make a difference in science, engineering, and real-world applications.
